title: add vpc control plane provisioning: private installer + terraform modules for subnets/endpoints-sgs-peering-route53
author: Priya Sharma
body:
Motivation: Add opinionated, production-ready Terraform modules and private-installer hooks to provision a VPC-based control plane for Redwood Private deployments. This PR includes subnet and route table wiring, interface and gateway endpoints for S3/SSM/EC2 endpoints, security group templates, cross-account peering helper modules, and optional Route53 private hosted zone setup and zone association automation. The goal is to provide a reproducible default that customers can use with the private-installer and the Helm charts while keeping options for advanced customizations.

What this PR does (high level):
- New Terraform modules under modules/vpc-control-plane: subnets, nat-gateway/route-tables, interface-endpoints, gateway-endpoints, security-groups, peering, route53-private-zone and zone-association.
- Private installer (installer/privatedeploy) integration: hooks to call the Terraform modules with sensible defaults, idempotent state handling, and upgrade/rollback hooks for multi-az upgrades.
- Helm chart tweaks (charts/private-control-plane): values to disable/override provisioning flow, RBAC/service account annotations for VPC API calls, and readiness probes to wait for interface endpoints.
- Documentation: docs/private-deploy/vpc-provisioning.md with architecture diagram and recommended parameter matrix.
- Tests: unit tests for Terraform module variable validation (terraform validate + terratest snippets) and installer e2e smoke test that runs in CI (mock AWS account).

Checklist: 
- [x] Terraform modules implemented and unit-tested.
- [x] Installer integration with idempotent apply/plan checks.
- [x] Helm chart flags and migration notes.
- [x] Docs and upgrade notes.
- [x] Security review for SG defaults and least-privileged IAM.

Backward compatibility and safety: By default the private installer will not execute provisioning unless the user opts in (values: provisionVPC: true). The installer supports a dry-run mode and a force-apply flag for operator-driven upgrades. Cross-account peering uses an explicit accept workflow with pre-flight checks. Route53 association is optional and gated behind a flag (createRoute53: true).

Operational notes: The modules are designed for multi-AZ subnets (private/public) and include automatic NAT gateway placement per AZ as an option. Interface endpoints created: com.amazonaws.<region>.s3, ecr.api, ecr.dkr, ssm, ec2messages, ssmmessages, secretsmanager. Gateway endpoints: s3 (when requested). Security groups default to deny-all inbound; control-plane-to-data-plane rules are configurable.

Testing and CI: CI adds a new job terraform-module-smoke that runs terraform fmt/validate and a lightweight terratest plan against mocked AWS credentials. Full integration tests were run in staging account.

Notes for reviewers: Focus on the module variable names and the installer upgrade hooks (installer/privatedeploy/upgrade_hook.sh). The SSH bastion/management CIDR is intentionally required to avoid opening access.

References: Linear ENG-4128, design doc: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-4128/vpc-control-plane-provisioning, internal runbook: docs/runbooks/private-vpc-provisioning.md
commits_summary: 7 commits: initial module scaffolding; add subnet/route-table module with multi-az support; interface/gateway endpoints module; security groups and peering helpers; installer hook and CLI integration; helm chart flags and readiness checks; docs and tests.
review_comments: Ethan Cole: Please ensure SG defaults don't accidentally allow 0.0.0.0/0 egress—we want to be restrictive by default.
Priya Sharma (author): Updated SG rules to require explicit egress_cidrs variable; added tests for default deny inbound policy.
Lina Alvarez: Can we make route53 association idempotent for cross-account cases? Edge-case when association already exists.
Priya Sharma (author): Added check in terraform-wrapper to detect existing associations and skip; documented behavior in docs file.
Marcus Chen: CI terratest is flaky in us-west-2 due to account limits; consider running smoke tests in a mocked mode for PRs.
Priya Sharma (author): Implemented mocked plan mode for PR CI; full terratest kept for scheduled nightly runs.
merge_details:
Merged by Lina Alvarez via squash merge. Commit message: 'vpc(control-plane): add terraform modules + private-installer integration for subnets/endpoints/peering/route53

Provides a safe, opt-in provisioning path for Redwood Private control planes.'
release_notes: Add opt-in VPC provisioning for Redwood Private: Terraform modules and private-installer hooks to provision subnets, endpoints, security groups, peering, and optional Route53 private zone. See docs/private-deploy/vpc-provisioning.md for migration and upgrade notes.
notes: This PR consolidates previous experimental modules and standardizes naming/variables. Operators should run private-installer with provisionVPC: true and monitor ci/jobs/terraform-module-smoke for baseline checks.
